scientific_limitations: The construction gives infinitely many progressions of length \(2b+1\) at fixed difference \(b-1\) for each odd \(b\); it does not determine the maximum length in odd bases.
The construction is arithmetically explicit but can produce very large first starts; no effective least-start bound is claimed.
A separately inaccessible full journal version and unindexed equivalent results remain bibliographic risks.
title: Long fixed-step anti-Niven progressions in every odd base
